svg.title: Debt incidence and the borrower median describe two different dimensions
svg.desc: Scatter chart. Horizontal axis: Graduates with debt (%). Vertical axis: Median debt among graduation debtors (CAD). Filled larger point: selected source level. Hollow points: other source views. The All levels point is an overlapping aggregate, not an additional disjoint population. Bracketed codes describe the incidence and median estimates, in that order. Points are historical group estimates; neither axis describes a personal forecast. Exact values are available in the chart data table below.
